recognize_zh: 這是教學示意圖：以虛線框出前軀幹範圍，並將其等分（A 圖四等分、B 圖三等分），用紅疹覆蓋的高度比例估算該區域皮膚侵犯百分比（A 約 70%，B 圖上方 100% 加下方 35%），用於慢性移植物抗宿主病 NIH 皮膚評分，並非細胞形態學。
features: Anterior trunk photographs with diffuse erythematous maculopapular eruption
A: trunk area outlined (blue dashed) and divided into four equal horizontal segments; involvement extends about 70% of the height
B: upper region scored as 100% involved and lower region subdivided into thirds with 35% involvement
Black horizontal line marks the lower limit of involvement
describe_en: This figure is a teaching diagram overlaid on clinical photographs of the anterior trunk with a diffuse erythematous maculopapular eruption. In panel A, the body area is outlined and divided into four equal horizontal segments, and the rash extends down to the black line, corresponding to approximately 70% involvement of that body area. In panel B, the area above the costal margin is scored as fully (100%) involved, and the remaining lower region, divided into thirds, is estimated as 35% involved. The approach illustrates how to estimate the percentage of body surface area affected within a region for NIH chronic GVHD skin scoring, where the proportion of involved body surface area determines skin severity.
captions: A: Four-segment division yielding about 70% involvement; B: 100% upper region plus 35% of lower region
